messages:
Alex G: Quick sync — drafting release notes for tomorrow's microdeploy (v2.3.1). Main ask: ops confirm pinned model revisions and canary window. I'd like a short internal blurb + rollback matrix.
Jamie L: Ack. I can do the blurb. Can you paste the model pins you want to include?
Alex G: Thanks. Pins:
```
model: redwood-bert-v2 -> sha: a1f3c9
model: llama-quant-7b -> sha: b7e2d4
```
Sarah M: Ops confirmed those SHAs on staging. Canary window 02:00-02:20 UTC. We'll run 10% traffic then 50% if green.
Kevin T: I will own rollback. Rollback criteria: >3% error rate or latency p95 > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive minutes.
Maria P: Draft internal blurb (short): "We are deploying v2.3.1 with model pins for stability. Canary 02:00 UTC; ops monitor. Reach out to #eng-oncall for issues." Want it shorter?
Jamie L: That's perfect. I'll add links to the RN doc and the deploy checklist.
Alex G: Deploy-bot, can you post the canary schedule and create a deploy run? @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary run created #deploy-run-1739987650 — ETA 2024-09-10 02:00 UTC. Steps: preflight -> canary 10% -> promo 50% -> full. Logs at https://ci.example/1739987650
Alex G: Great. Can someone add the rollback snippet to the RN? Suggestion:
```
Rollback steps:
1) Pause routing to canary pool
2) Revert service to previous model sha
3) Promote stable route
```
Sarah M: Added to RN, and I'll pin the SHA in the release metadata. Also setting a short-lived metric alert for latency and error rate.
Kevin T: I'll be watching pager, but also leaving a manual rollback window 02:00-03:00 UTC.
Maria P: Final internal announce copy:
"Heads-up: v2.3.1 goes canary 02:00 UTC. Pinned model SHAs. Ops will monitor; rollback if errors/latency. Contact #eng-oncall if anything." 
Jamie L: I'll post the internal announcement 30 mins before canary. Alex can you give thumbs? :thumbsup:
Alex G: :thumbsup: go ahead. Thanks all.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary run will emit status updates in #release-notifications. Set reminder 30m before canary.
Jamie L: Reminder set. I'll also attach the RN doc and rollback playbook in the announce thread.
Alex G: Closing — RN draft reviewed, deploy run created, rollback owner assigned. Thanks.
